predictions.selection_reason: External dataTypeExpression -> regex parsing with core_rnotwhite -> affects AJAX prefilter/transport selection and data processing
predictions.source_summary: dataTypeExpression parameter passed to jQuery.ajaxPrefilter() or jQuery.ajaxTransport() calls, which can be user-provided strings like "json jsonp" or "script"
predictions.sink_summary: Parsed data types are used to register prefilters/transports in internal structures that control AJAX request processing, data type handling, and potentially script execution
predictions.guard_summary: No input validation or sanitization on dataTypeExpression before regex parsing; only basic type check that defaults to "*" if not string
predictions.risk_pattern: User-controlled dataTypeExpression is parsed with regex /\S+/g to split on whitespace, then used to register AJAX processing handlers without validation
predictions.context_summary: Function registers AJAX prefilters/transports based on space-separated data type expressions; used for core AJAX functionality including script and JSONP handling
unresolved_facts: Specific security impact depends on how registered prefilters/transports handle malicious data types
Whether malicious dataTypeExpression could bypass security controls in specific prefilter/transport implementations
